source.notes: ICSE 2024 board examination paper, Biology (Science Paper – 3), from the official CISCE Archive Library ZIP bundle. Paper code printed on every page: 'T24 523'. Maximum Marks 80, time allowed two hours (as printed). No official marking scheme is published with this paper; questions carry no official answer. Section A (40 marks) is compulsory: Question 1 has fifteen 1-mark MCQs ([15] printed for the whole question) and Question 2 has five 5-mark sub-questions (i)-(v), each of five 1-mark items (a)-(e) (marks derived from the printed [5] per sub-question, so marksSource is SECTION_INSTRUCTIONS); each item is its own entry, e.g. part '(i)(a)'. Section B prints 'Attempt any four questions from this Section' over six 10-mark questions (3-8): this is a pick-4-of-6 choice, not an OR pair, so choiceGroup is not used and the marks in this file total 100 (40 + 60) against the printed maximum of 80. Section B sub-parts (i)-(v) are separate entries with their printed marks; a sub-part whose (a)-(c) items share one figure or scenario is kept together. No cognitive-level tags are printed on this paper. The PDF has 11 pages ('This paper consists of 11 printed pages and 1 blank page'; the blank page is not in the PDF). Question 1 items (viii)-(x) (page 3) and (xiii)-(xiv) (page 4) are set with labels and stems in separate columns; stems were paired with labels in printed order. Item 1(xiii) is an assertion-reason item.
source.usage: Official CISCE board examination paper from the CISCE Archive Library (cisce.org/archive-library); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to the original. Figures are not reproduced.

questions.text:
Study the diagram given below and fill in the blanks with suitable words:
In order to prove that carbon dioxide is necessary for (a) ___________, a potted plant is placed in dark for 48 hours to (b) __________ the leaves. A part of a leaf is inserted into a conical flask containing potassium hydroxide solution. This is to absorb (c) ___________ from the flask. The plant is then placed in sunlight for a few hours. The experimental leaf is tested for starch. The part of the leaf that was inside the conical flask turns (d) ___________, whereas the part of the leaf outside turns (e) __________ in colour.
extractionIssues: One continuous fill-in-the-blank passage with blanks (a)-(e); the full passage is repeated in each of the 5 entries and the target blank is given by this entry's part label
